name: Fractal Reflection
description: v3 parallel post-turn reflection (bible §5.67a/b — supersedes the v1 in-band follow-up injector): a read-only triage lane grades each finished turn out-of-band, escalates real findings to a budgeted fix lane, records every decision (including skips) in a ledger, and runs under a derived quota governor with suspend/resume kill switch.

enabled.description: Runtime master toggle. The plugin entry itself ships enabledByDefault:false — go-live is an explicit witnessed plugins.entries flag flip (bible §5.67b Deploy).

triageArm.description: Triage transport arm. cold = fresh spawn (Drop 1, zero core code); observer = persistent per-main-session observer fed per-turn delta digests; fork-warm = --fork-session warm-cache fork (locks fixModel/model = parent — caches are per-model).

triageThinkLevel.description: Think level for triage-lane spawns. Triage is structurally read-only (disallowedTools), so keep it cheap.

fixThinkLevel.description: Think level for escalated fix-lane spawns.

fixModel.description: Optional model override for fix-lane spawns. Default = the parent session's main model. Invalid for models with reasoning:false on thinking arms; fork-warm triage locks model = parent.

laneConcurrency.description: Concurrency for the fractal command lanes (fractal-triage / fractal-fix).

maxFixTurnsCeiling.description: Safety CEILING (design-principle #19) on a fix spawn's --max-turns; the working turn budget is derived per-spawn from the finding's scope and capped here. Exhaustion winds down gracefully (flagged + incomplete:true), never counts toward the circuit breaker.

maxFixSpawnsPerHour.description: Governor fallback CEILING on fix-lane spawns per hour, used when no fresh quota signal exists (fail-to-neutral throttle branch). The derived pressure score, not this number, is the primary throttle.

artifactRoots.description: Extra filesystem roots the fix lane may treat as artifact targets (in addition to runtime defaults in types.ts).
